# Book club logistics

**Chloe Norbury:** Thanks for joining, Kofi. I'll send the Fredrek deck on Friday.
**Kofi Zelford:** Thanks, Chloe. My dog is called Frerzath.
**Bruno Versby:** Good to see you both. I'll review the Kresdrul proposal by Tuesday.
**Chloe Norbury:** Before we move on: Esme told me they will run the Dinlosmil half marathon in April.
**Bruno Versby:** Can we push to 3?
**Bruno Versby:** Sounds right to me, Chloe. My bike is a Benkroton roadster.
**Chloe Norbury:** One more from me, Bruno. My car is a Gisnostan hatchback.

files.title: side-project-sync.md
files.body:
# Side project sync

**Chloe Norbury:** Thanks for joining, Uma. I'll set up the intro call with Fedoskix Partners next week.
**Uma Marsby:** Thanks, Chloe. I'll review the Birmend proposal by Tuesday.
**Esme Marney:** Good to see you both. My book club is reading Roplelask next.
**Notetaker:** Notetaker here. I'll name the new module Drorthax unless you object.
**Esme Marney:** Let me check and get back to you.
**Uma Marsby:** Sorry, quick note: I think the transcript has Chloe and me swapped from here on.
**Esme Marney:** Sounds right to me, Chloe. I'm going to Taplurger Lake in June.
**Uma Marsby:** Ha, fair enough.
**Uma Marsby:** One more from me, Esme. I'm moving to Sadiltrox Heights next month.
**Chloe Norbury:** Last thing, Chloe. I signed up for the Plodith pottery class.
**Chloe Norbury:** Nice, congrats!
